title: Dependabot
description: Documented public dependency updater (GitHub) for the Dependency Health Monitor capability area.
body:
Dependabot is a documented dependency updater from GitHub. GitHub's automated dependency updater opening PRs for vulnerable or outdated packages — the default health monitor.

How it works: It works by scanning the code sample for banned patterns (eval), style issues (var), and markers (TODO), reporting findings by severity.
